_comment: Default tool roles of the Sanity flow (docs/spec/sanity-flow.md): Synopsys VC Static (/tools/Synopsys/vc_static, module synopsys/vc_static). Used by this flow only, when no tools.json / tools.roles of the project defines `cdc` / `rdc`. The Tcl setup script (sanity/<role>_setup.tcl) is written by Q3TUI; the violations are read from the report it writes (lib/vcstatic.py); `parse` only says when the tool itself failed.

cdc.description: static clock domain crossing analysis (VC Static: check_cdc, report_violations -app CDC)

rdc.description: static reset domain crossing analysis (VC Static: check_rdc, report_rdc)
